'''Kiril Atanasov Popov''' (Кирил Атанасов Попов) (May 3, 1880 - May 1, 1966) was a Bulgarian mathematician who is best known for his contributions to the fields of [[ballistics]] and [[thermodynamics]].

== Early life ==
Kiril Popov was born in [[Shumen]], [[Bulgaria]] in 1880. His father, Atanas Popov, was a merchant who participated in the Bulgarian revolutionary movement in [[Tsargrad]], where he was imprisoned for his activity against the [[Ottoman Empire]].<ref>Борис Попов за Кирил Попов. [http://mmib.math.bas.bg/wp-content/uploads/12016-BM075-K_Popov_BPopov.pdf Български математици. – София: Народна просвета], 1987, с. 75-78 (Препечатана с незначителни промени от Математика и физика, 1980. Кн. 6, с. 41-45)</ref><ref>Попов, Кирил. Автобиография. – София: Изд. на СУ, 1993</ref> After the [[Liberation of Bulgaria]], Atanas returned to his hometown Shumen, where he married Anastasia, the mother of Kiril.<ref>Попов, Кирил. Автобиография. – София: Изд. на СУ, 1993</ref> Kiril had three siblings: brothers Metodi and Kosta and sister Ekaterina.<ref>Борис Попов за Кирил Попов. [http://mmib.math.bas.bg/wp-content/uploads/12016-BM075-K_Popov_BPopov.pdf Български математици. – София: Народна просвета], 1987, с. 75-78 (Препечатана с незначителни промени от Математика и физика, 1980. Кн. 6, с. 41-45)</ref> In 1885, the family moved to [[Varna, Bulgaria|Varna]], where Kiril and Metodi enrolled in a preschool.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Кирил Попов – Биография {{!}} Математиката и информатиката в България |url=http://mmib.math.bas.bg/?page_id=1745 |access-date=2023-07-17 |language=en-US}}</ref> After a few days there, Kiril got bored and sneaked into the nearby school, where he stayed for the next four years until he finished his primary education.<ref>Попов, Кирил. Автобиография. – София: Изд. на СУ, 1993</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Кирил Попов – Биография {{!}} Математиката и информатиката в България |url=http://mmib.math.bas.bg/?page_id=1745 |access-date=2023-07-17 |language=en-US}}</ref> While in secondary school, Kiril became a proficient violin player and taught himself Russian and French.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Кирил Попов – Биография {{!}} Математиката и информатиката в България |url=http://mmib.math.bas.bg/?page_id=1745 |access-date=2023-07-17 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>Борис Попов за Кирил Попов. [http://mmib.math.bas.bg/wp-content/uploads/12016-BM075-K_Popov_BPopov.pdf Български математици. – София: Народна просвета], 1987, с. 75-78 (Препечатана с незначителни промени от Математика и физика, 1980. Кн. 6, с. 41-45)</ref>

== Education ==
After graduation from secondary school, Kiril taught for one year in the Varna primary school “Otets Paisiy” to save money for further education.<ref>Русев, Петър. [http://www.math.bas.bg/smb/2004_2007_PK/2005/pdf/017-021.pdf 125 години от рождението на академик Кирил Попов (1880-1966)]. Математика и математическо образование. Сборник доклади от 34-та Пролетна конференция на СМБ, 2005, с. 17-2</ref><ref>Борис Попов за Кирил Попов. [http://mmib.math.bas.bg/wp-content/uploads/12016-BM075-K_Popov_BPopov.pdf Български математици. – София: Народна просвета], 1987, с. 75-78 (Препечатана с незначителни промени от Математика и физика, 1980. Кн. 6, с. 41-45)</ref> In 1894 he enrolled in the Faculty of Physics and Mathematics in [[Sofia]]. A year later, he obtained a scholarship that enabled him to finance both his studies and the education of his brother, Metodi.<ref>Борис Попов за Кирил Попов. [http://mmib.math.bas.bg/wp-content/uploads/12016-BM075-K_Popov_BPopov.pdf Български математици. – София: Народна просвета], 1987, с. 75-78 (Препечатана с незначителни промени от Математика и физика, 1980. Кн. 6, с. 41-45)</ref><ref>Попов, Кирил. Автобиография. – София: Изд. на СУ, 1993</ref> After graduating, Kiril worked for two years as a teacher. During that time, he became interested in the works of [[Ernst Mach]] and [[Henri Poincaré|Henri Poincarè]].<ref>Попов, Кирил. Автобиография. – София: Изд. на СУ, 1993</ref>

In 1904, Popov was selected as an assistant in the Faculty of Physics and Mathematics in Sofia. In 1906 and 1907, Popov worked in the [https://sternwarte-muenchen.de/en/ Munich], [[Heidelberg-Königstuhl State Observatory|Heidelberg]], and [[Nice Observatory|Nice observatories]]. At that time, he learned about the [[three-body problem]] and [[Poincaré–Lindstedt method|Poincare's contributions to perturbation theory]] which became the basis of his early research. J. A. L. Bassot, the Director General of the Nice observatory, recommended him as a candidate for further studies at the [[Sorbonne University|Sorbonne]], and in 1908, he is accepted there without having to sit an entrance exam.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Кирил Попов – Биография {{!}} Математиката и информатиката в България |url=http://mmib.math.bas.bg/?page_id=1745 |access-date=2023-07-17 |language=en-US}}</ref>  

While at the Sorbonne, Popov worked at the [[Paris Observatory|Paris observatory]] and attended the lectures of [[Édouard Goursat]], [[Émile Picard]], and [[Henri Poincaré|Henri Poincarè]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://mmib.math.bas.bg/wp-content/uploads/12016-BM075-K_Popov_BPopov.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240630113115/http://mmib.math.bas.bg/wp-content/uploads/12016-BM075-K_Popov_BPopov.pdf|archive-date=2024-06-30|title=Борис Попов за Кирил Попов}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Кирил Попов – Биография {{!}} Математиката и информатиката в България |url=http://mmib.math.bas.bg/?page_id=1745 |access-date=2023-07-17 |language=en-US}}</ref> He became enthralled by Poincarè's work on the motions of celestial bodies and started doctoral studies under the supervision of the French mathematician.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Kiril Popov - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=142789 |access-date=2023-07-17 |website=www.mathgenealogy.org}}</ref> While working on computations for the orbit of [[108 Hecuba]], Popov found a mistake in Poincarè's equations that lead to incorrect predictions.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2017-06-22 |title=Принос в решаването на задачата за три тела ( Кирил Попов ) |url=https://www.zagrada.bg/prinos-v-reshavaneto-na-zadachata-za-tri-tela-kiril-popov/ |access-date=2023-07-17 |website=zagrada.bg |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Кирил Попов – Другите за него {{!}} Математиката и информатиката в България |url=http://mmib.math.bas.bg/?page_id=2266 |access-date=2023-07-17 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>Борис Попов за Кирил Попов. [http://mmib.math.bas.bg/wp-content/uploads/12016-BM075-K_Popov_BPopov.pdf Български математици. – София: Народна просвета], 1987, с. 75-78 (Препечатана с незначителни промени от Математика и физика, 1980. Кн. 6, с. 41-45)</ref> During his time as a doctoral student, Popov had the chance to work in the observatories in [[Greenwich]], [[Observatory of Strasbourg|Strasbourg]], and [[Royal Observatory, Greenwich|London]]. In 1909, he returned to his position as an assistant at [[Sofia University]] and spent the following two years writing his doctoral thesis, “Sur le mouvement de 108 Hecube”, which he defended at the Sorbonne in 1912.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Kiril Popov - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=142789 |access-date=2023-07-17 |website=www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Кирил Попов – Биография {{!}} Математиката и информатиката в България |url=http://mmib.math.bas.bg/?page_id=1745 |access-date=2023-07-17 |language=en-US}}</ref> After the defense, Popov had to return to Bulgaria as he was drafted into the army at the start of the [[Balkan Wars|Balkan wars]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Кирил Попов – Биография {{!}} Математиката и информатиката в България |url=http://mmib.math.bas.bg/?page_id=1745 |access-date=2023-07-17 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>Русев, Петър. [http://www.math.bas.bg/smb/2004_2007_PK/2005/pdf/017-021.pdf 125 години от рождението на академик Кирил Попов (1880-1966)]. Математика и математическо образование. Сборник доклади от 34-та Пролетна конференция на СМБ, 2005, с. 17-2</ref>  

== Career ==
In 1914, Popov was selected as an associate professor in the Faculty of Physics and Mathematics in Sofia and became interested in ballistics.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2017-06-22 |title=Принос в решаването на задачата за три тела ( Кирил Попов ) |url=https://www.zagrada.bg/prinos-v-reshavaneto-na-zadachata-za-tri-tela-kiril-popov/ |access-date=2023-07-17 |website=zagrada.bg |language=en-US}}</ref> By 1917, he was granted the highest title in the [[Bulgarian Academy of Sciences]]: an [[academician]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Кирил Попов – Биография {{!}} Математиката и информатиката в България |url=http://mmib.math.bas.bg/?page_id=1745 |access-date=2023-07-17 |language=en-US}}</ref> In 1920, after several successful works in the field,<ref>{{Cite web |title=La balistique extérieure - Volume (1934) no. 65 |url=http://www.numdam.org/issues/MSM_1934__65__1_0/ |access-date=2023-07-17 |website=www.numdam.org}}</ref> Popov was invited to give a lecture course on ballistics at the university in Berlin, where he met [[Richard von Mises]].<ref>Русев, Петър. [http://www.math.bas.bg/smb/2004_2007_PK/2005/pdf/017-021.pdf 125 години от рождението на академик Кирил Попов (1880-1966)]. Математика и математическо образование. Сборник доклади от 34-та Пролетна конференция на СМБ, 2005, с. 17-2</ref> The course was developed into a book that was published with a preface by Èmile Picard.<ref>{{Cite web |title=La balistique extérieure - Volume (1934) no. 65 |url=http://www.numdam.org/issues/MSM_1934__65__1_0/ |access-date=2023-07-17 |website=www.numdam.org}}</ref> From 1925 onwards, Popov became a regular visitor to the Sorbonne and the university in Berlin, where he kept delivering lectures.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2017-06-22 |title=Принос в решаването на задачата за три тела ( Кирил Попов ) |url=https://www.zagrada.bg/prinos-v-reshavaneto-na-zadachata-za-tri-tela-kiril-popov/ |access-date=2023-07-17 |website=zagrada.bg |language=en-US}}</ref> In 1926, Popov received the ''[[Montyon Prize]]'' for his work on mechanics.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Кирил Попов – Биография {{!}} Математиката и информатиката в България |url=http://mmib.math.bas.bg/?page_id=1745 |access-date=2023-07-17 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>Русев, Петър. [http://www.math.bas.bg/smb/2004_2007_PK/2005/pdf/017-021.pdf 125 години от рождението на академик Кирил Попов (1880-1966)]. Математика и математическо образование. Сборник доклади от 34-та Пролетна конференция на СМБ, 2005, с. 17-2</ref>  

In his later years, Popov started working on thermodynamics. Between 1952 and 1958 he developed a series of 18 papers on the dynamics of [[irreversible process]]es, for which he was awarded the ''Henri de Parville Prize'' by the [[French Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Кирил Попов – Биография {{!}} Математиката и информатиката в България |url=http://mmib.math.bas.bg/?page_id=1745 |access-date=2023-07-17 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>Борис Попов за Кирил Попов. [http://mmib.math.bas.bg/wp-content/uploads/12016-BM075-K_Popov_BPopov.pdf Български математици. – София: Народна просвета], 1987, с. 75-78 (Препечатана с незначителни промени от Математика и физика, 1980. Кн. 6, с. 41-45)</ref>  

== Later life and recognition  ==
Kiril Popov continued remained active in the European mathematical scene until his death in 1966.<ref>Асен Дацев за Кирил Попов. [http://mmib.math.bas.bg/wp-content/uploads/12017-BM078-K_Popov_ADacev.pdf Български математици. – София: Народна просвета], 1987, с. 78-79 (Препечатана с известни съкращения в Физико-математическо сп., 1962, т. 5 (38), Кн. 2, с. 149-150)</ref> During his lifetime, he published more than 150 scientific works for which he was honored with a variety of accolades.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Кирил Попов – Биография {{!}} Математиката и информатиката в България |url=http://mmib.math.bas.bg/?page_id=1745 |access-date=2023-07-17 |language=en-US}}</ref> Posthumously, the Bulgarian mathematics competition “Academic Kiril Popov” and the mathematics high school in [[Plovdiv]] were named in his honor.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Кирил Попов – Биография {{!}} Математиката и информатиката в България |url=http://mmib.math.bas.bg/?page_id=1745 |access-date=2023-07-17 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Данибон |date=2023-04-05 |title=Математически турнир “Академик Кирил Попов” (2023) – ЗАДАЧИ, ОТГОВОРИ, РЕЗУЛТАТИ - Danybon.com |url=https://danybon.com/obrazovanie/math-kiril-popov-2023/,%20https://danybon.com/obrazovanie/math-kiril-popov-2023/ |access-date=2023-07-17 |language=bg-BG}}</ref>

== Notable works ==

# Sur le mouvement de 108 Hécube, 1912
# Das Hauptproblem der äußeren Ballistik im Lichte der modernen Mathematik, Leipzig, Akademische Verlagsgesellschaft, 1932
# Le mouvement d’un projectile autour de son centre de gravité, Mémorial des sciences mathématiques, 107, Paris, Gauthier-Villars, 1951
# Les bases mathématiques de la théorie des processus thermodinamiques irréversibles, Mémorial des sciences physiques, 63, Paris, Gauthier-Villars, 1956

== Awards ==
1947: Elected academician of the Bulgarian Academy of Sciences

1926: Montion Prize, Académie des sciences

1957: Henri de Parville Prize, Académie des sciences

Dimitrovgrad Award (twice)

[[:bg:Почетно звание „Народен“|Bulgarian National Award]]
